summary.text: Grayson Lookner is a Democratic state representative from Portland, Maine, who represents District 113 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes work as a community organizer, emergency medical technician, behavioral health professional and newspaper columnist.

paragraphs.text: He earned an associate degree in emergency medical technology from Yavapai College and a bachelor's degree in sociology from Prescott College.
His career experience includes working as a community organizer, an emergency medical technician, a behavioral health professional and a newspaper columnist.
He has served on the board of trustees of the Stroudwater Neighborhood Association.

Lookner serves in the Maine House of Representatives for District 113, and Ballotpedia lists the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee as his committee assignment for the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
